notes: Fixes 'the model returned an empty reply' from the vision endpoint. The request was actually succeeding — but some RunPod vLLM configurations answer a streaming request with one plain JSON completion instead of a token stream, and the reply parser only understood streamed deltas, so a perfectly good answer parsed to nothing. The parser now accepts every shape a reply arrives in (streamed deltas, a whole message, completions-style text, or a single JSON body), surfaces server-side errors by name, and when a reply genuinely carries no tokens, records the start of the raw response in the troubleshooting log so the cause is visible instead of guessed.
